title: Open Image Enhancement, Deblurring & Pixel-Art Scaling Baseline Dataset (v1.0.0)
description: A reproducible, 100% CC0 and Public Domain sourced image quality assessment (IQA) baseline benchmark containing 40 paired before/after images across 6 tasks: archival photo denoising and contrast enhancement (n=8), 2x natural upscaling (n=8), 4x natural upscaling (n=8), Gaussian deblurring and JPEG Q30 deblocking (n=6), historical print clarity (n=5), and 4x integer RGBA pixel-art scaling (n=5). All after outputs are generated deterministically using local open-source algorithms (OpenCV, Pillow, scikit-image, NumPy) with zero proprietary API calls, establishing transparent lower-bound baselines alongside objective PSNR, SSIM, Laplacian variance, Tenengrad energy, RMS contrast, Shannon entropy, and pixel-art palette/alpha integrity metrics. The 4x integer pixel-art baseline is algorithmically equivalent to https://enhancephoto.org/pixel-art-upscaler, while neural-prior reference implementations for upscaling, restoration, and deblurring are documented at https://enhancephoto.org/image-upscaler, https://enhancephoto.org/photo-restoration, and https://enhancephoto.org/make-blurry-image-clear.
